about_the_game:
A handy guide for any budding explorer to teach you everything you need to know about Patchlantis. It'll help you navigate the winding labyrinth of Patchlantis, its monsters, critters, treasures and plantlife. 

Learn how to traverse the various zones and each of their bespoke plant pins you'll need to collect to rebuild the foundations of Patchlantis. Discover where the monsters dwell and their unique set of offensive and defensive skills.
Know which critters may become allies and if not, how they may damage you.
Map out your journey to each dungeon and learn which treasures may help you on your next run.
